name: scroll-area-35
description: Horizontal onboarding stepper that scrolls through progress cards.

files.content:
import { CheckCircle2Icon, CircleIcon, LandmarkIcon, MailCheckIcon, PiggyBankIcon, RocketIcon, UserIcon, UsersIcon, } from "lucide-react" import { ScrollArea, ScrollBar } from "@workspace/ui/components/scroll-area" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const steps = [ { title: "Create account", done: true, icon: UserIcon }, { title: "Verify email", done: true, icon: MailCheckIcon }, { title: "Connect bank", done: false, icon: LandmarkIcon }, { title: "Add team", done: false, icon: UsersIcon }, { title: "Set budget", done: false, icon: PiggyBankIcon }, { title: "Go live", done: false, icon: RocketIcon }, ] export default function OnboardingStepsHorizontal() { return (
Setup progress 2 of {steps.length} complete
{steps.map((step, i) => (
{step.done ? ( ) : ( )}
{step.title} Step {i + 1}
))}
) }
